meta.title: Active Markdown
meta.description: Long Markdown previews read as one page, and English docs have no Chinese view. Takes over the sidebar body and renders blocks; translates line-aligned from Translated and looks up the source of a selected range; annotate a source selection, or a table/code block as a whole, then attach the feedback as a Markdown file in the composer; set the model, target language, and code comments on the plugin page.
